notes.title: STEAM INVENTORY - AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790581/1878227b771588603cc6cc1f9738f5017af9a559.jpg[/img]
🖼️ From now on, you’ll receive a new face image of one of the girls every day!
You can:

[list]
[*] ✨ Set it as your main menu background,
[*] 🔁 Trade it with other players,
[*] 💰 Sell it on the Steam Marketplace!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790581/a6f1a61627e3f8a4fe24a00b2f5d1c951ace3e7c.gif[/img]

And this is just the beginning — more surprises and even spicier content are coming soon! 👀🔥
